findings.explanation: Prose treats syntax characters `]` and `[` as field names due to corrupted template parsing of multisearch subsearches.
findings.quote: Synthetic probe on `cluster`, `]`, `[`, `search` — Health checks in `openshift` populate the same fields the SPL groups on.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite the scenario to reference actual cluster and machine attributes without bracket token artifacts.

summary: While detailedImplementation and SPL provide thorough and technically sound OpenShift MachineHealthCheck lifecycle coverage, prose fields including description, controlTest, and knownFalsePositives contain severe template residue and bracket token-salad artifacts.
